Title: Application Insights SDK and support for Java

Body.Content: Get actionable insights into your live Java web application. Use the telemetry API to send events, metrics, and exception reports to Application Insights. Add a logging appender to explore your Logback or log4J trace logs and other events in the Application Insights portal. Learn more about the Application Insights SDK for Java Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
Body.Markdown:
Get actionable insights into your live Java web application. Use the telemetry API to send events, metrics, and exception reports to Application Insights. Add a logging appender to explore your Logback or log4J trace logs and other events in the Application Insights portal.

Learn more about the Application Insights SDK for Java

Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
